notes:
User enjoys experimenting with coffee, especially French press and citrus notes (S1.U1). Preferred French press ratio is 1 tablespoon coffee per 5 ounces water (S2.U1; superseded: 1 per 6 oz, S1.U1). They chose Kenyan beans first (S1.U2), plan to pair citrus coffee with Earl Grey (S1.U3), and signed up for a coffee subscription last month, receiving their first shipment yesterday (S1.U4). They are excited to brew the new beans in French press and expect bright flavors to complement citrus notes (S1.U6); they asked about bean freshness/storage and brewing (S1.U6).

User enjoys exploring teas and wants a relaxing blend similar to chamomile for this weekend (S2.U1). They plan to organize their tea cabinet and asked how to store leaves to preserve freshness (S2.U2–S2.U3). They are considering a tea subscription and will compare Adagio Teas and The Tea Spot, including new-customer promotions (S2.U3–S2.U4). They asked how to clean a French press thoroughly to remove old coffee oils (S2.U5). Their sister introduced them to a new rose tea, and they wonder whether it pairs with sweet shortbread cookies (S2.U6).

They asked for advice on preserving bean freshness, including storage and brewing considerations (S1.U6).
